The '''Raid on Bilbringi''' was a raid by the newly established [[Smugglers' Alliance]] on the part of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Mazzic]] and [[Ellor]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] in retaliation of the [[Ambush on Trogan]].

==Prelude==
After the Imperial ambush during the smuggler meeting on [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]], [[Mazzic]] and [[Ellor]] needed to teach the Empire a lesson and attacked the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] to avenge the death of the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] smuggler [[Lishma]].

==The raid==
Around twenty of Mazzic's [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] penetrated discreetly the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|system]] and destroyed a nearly completed [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] within the construction docks of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. The ships were attacked by [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], which were easily destroyed by Ellor's [[DP20 gunship/Legends|two Corellian Gunships]] that arrived to cover their escape.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Then I should like to hear your reasons why I should not order your immediate execution.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Niles Ferrier]]|<ref name="The Last Command" />}}
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was very angry about the loss of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and the implication of the smugglers in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]]. He tried to convince them that he wasn't responsible for the ambush on [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]] but failed because they quickly discovered that Ferrier was an Imperial agent and the organizer of the ambush.

[[Talon Karrde]], who had been invited to watch by Mazzic, was present during the raid, and just before the explosion of the Star Destroyer, he noticed the twenty-two [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that Thrawn would later use to [[Siege of Coruscant|attack]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
